newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH GDP GROWTH SLOWED IN AUGUST - SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH GDP GROWTH SLOWED IN AUGUST - SF.

text.p: The growth rate of Finland's gross domestic product (GDP) in August slowed to about the level of early last summer, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Thursday.
SF said earlier Finnish GDP rose 2.1 percent year-on-year in August after a 3.9 percent year-on-year rise in July, and it rose 0.3 percent in August on July.
Production increased in all the sectors in August, it said.
In industry and construction the output rose two percent year-on-year in August, while transport sector's growth rate was three percent, SF said.
The output of trade rose 1.5 percent year-on-year in August, and the output of other services and public sector rose two percent.
The output of farming rose one percent year-on-year, it said.
